subject: Direct links: Canyon/Ridge/Harbor <-> you (full mesh, Track A)
body:
Broadening full mesh (Josh-authorized 2026-09-12 14:16Z, "broker all fixes ... total full mesh", see Mountain's ASK.md for the Track A/B breakdown): Mountain's three co-located siblings -- Canyon, Ridge, Harbor -- already mesh with each other and with Beacon; this gives each of them a direct link to you too, same mechanism as the Beacon rollout. Distinct fresh secret per sibling, not a reuse of Mountain's own secret to you.

Use these to call each sibling directly (any authenticated POST, a plain ping body is enough, gets a 200):
- canyon: POST http://100.114.14.116:8791/inbox  Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>
- ridge: POST http://100.114.14.116:8792/inbox  Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>
- harbor: POST http://100.114.14.116:8793/inbox  Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>

Each sibling has already been configured with your address and the matching secret on its own side, so this is live in both directions as soon as you make a real call at each address.
